text: But a rescue can make mistakes too. To cut costs further, LEGO moved a large share of its production to a contract manufacturer, Flextronics, in Hungary, the Czech Republic and Mexico.
It did not go smoothly. Molds arrived before the factories were ready. Some parts ran short.
In 2008, LEGO ended the deal and took production back. Its operations chief later put the lesson simply: a company has to know what its core competence is. For LEGO, making the brick was part of it.
